## QC of genomes from chironomid project

This code will read in the gtdb output and checkm2 output for the chironomid genomes. 1) it will produce a genome taxonomy input file to hand off to dram. 2) it will analyze the genome quality

## Load data and clean

```{r load-libraries}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(kableExtra) # pretty tables
library(here)

theme_set(theme_bw())

```

```{r table-plotting-function}
#| include: false

make_table <- function(data,
                       height = "400px",
                       width = "100%",
                       caption = NULL,
                       striped = TRUE,
                       font_size = 13,
                       sortable = TRUE) {

  table <- data |>
    knitr::kable(
      format = "html",
      caption = caption,
      row.names = FALSE,
      escape = TRUE
    ) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c(
        if (striped) "striped",
        "hover",
        "condensed"
      ),
      full_width = TRUE,
      font_size = font_size
    ) |>
    kableExtra::scroll_box(
      width = width,
      height = height,
      fixed_thead = TRUE
    )

  if (!sortable) return(table)

  sort_js <- "
  (() => {
    const container = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
    const table = container.querySelector('table');
    if (!table || !table.tBodies.length) return;

    const headers = table.querySelectorAll('thead tr:last-child th');
    const tbody = table.tBodies[0];

    headers.forEach((th, col) => {
      th.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      th.tabIndex = 0;
      th.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      th.setAttribute('aria-label', th.textContent + ', sort column');
      th.setAttribute('aria-sort', 'none');

      const sort = () => {
        const asc = th.dataset.order !== 'asc';
        const rows = Array.from(tbody.rows);

        const numeric = rows.every(row => {
          const x = row.cells[col]?.textContent.trim() || '';
          return x === '' || !isNaN(Number(x.replace(/,/g, '')));
        });

        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          const x = a.cells[col]?.textContent.trim() || '';
          const y = b.cells[col]?.textContent.trim() || '';

          if (x === '') return y === '' ? 0 : 1;
          if (y === '') return -1;

          const result = numeric
            ? Number(x.replace(/,/g, '')) - Number(y.replace(/,/g, ''))
            : x.localeCompare(y, undefined, {
                numeric: true,
                sensitivity: 'base'
              });

          return asc ? result : -result;
        });

        rows.forEach(row => tbody.appendChild(row));

        headers.forEach(h => {
          h.dataset.order = '';
          h.setAttribute('aria-sort', 'none');
          h.querySelector('.sort-indicator')?.remove();
        });

        th.dataset.order = asc ? 'asc' : 'desc';
        th.setAttribute('aria-sort', asc ? 'ascending' : 'descending');

        const indicator = document.createElement('span');
        indicator.className = 'sort-indicator';
        indicator.textContent = asc ? ' ▲' : ' ▼';
        th.appendChild(indicator);
      };

      th.addEventListener('click', sort);
      th.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          sort();
        }
      });
    });
  })();
  "

  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(htmltools::HTML(as.character(table))),
    htmltools::tags$script(htmltools::HTML(sort_js))
  )
}


```

Read in data, combine bacterial and archaeal gtdb assignments.

```{r, read-data}
# Sample metadata (JGI and internal)
jgi_metadata_raw_headers <- names(readxl::read_xlsx(here("data/508066 MG MT metadata 052024 ER.xlsx"), n_max = 0))
jgi_metadata_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("data/508066 MG MT metadata 052024 ER.xlsx"), skip = 3, 
                                  col_names = jgi_metadata_raw_headers)
# contains internal experimental information;
# had to export to tsv because readxlsx doesn't like the "other samples" part
internal_metadata_raw <- read_tsv(here("data/JCBP_-80_samplelist_EG_updated_25042024.txt"))

# Join the two metadatas together
metadata_raw <- jgi_metadata_raw %>%
  left_join(internal_metadata_raw, by = c("Sample Name*" = "sample.name")) %>%
  mutate(sample_name_no_space = gsub(" ", "_", `Seq Project Name (No edit)`)) %>%
  select(`Sample Name*`, site, environment, enrichment, material, everything())


# Quality report
chkm_qual <- read_tsv(here("data/quality_report.tsv"))

# Taxonomy assignments
# From running "aviary annotate" with default settings; 
# aviary version: 0.13.4
# Gtdb version: release 232
gtdb_assignment_arch <- read_tsv(here("data/gtdbtk.ar53.summary.tsv"), na = c("","NA","N/A")) %>%
  mutate(msa_percent = as.double(msa_percent))
gtdb_assignment_bac <- read_tsv(here("data/gtdbtk.bac120.summary.tsv"), na = c("","NA","N/A")) %>%
  mutate(msa_percent = as.double(msa_percent))

gtdb_assignment_bacarc <- bind_rows(gtdb_assignment_arch, gtdb_assignment_bac)

```

#### Create and write out taxonomy file for DRAM

Dram taxonomy file just needs genome id and classification column.

```{r}
gtdb_dram_taxonomy <- gtdb_assignment_bacarc %>% 
  select(user_genome, classification)

write_tsv(gtdb_dram_taxonomy, file = here("data/gtdb_dram_taxonomy.tsv"))

```

Read in rrna information for MIMAG quality

```{r}
rrnas_raw <- read_tsv(here("data/ANNOTATE/collected_rrnas.tsv"))

rrnas <- rrnas_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(!matches(c("gene_id", "gene_description", "category", "topic_ecosystem", "subcategory")),
               names_to = "GenomeID", values_to = "Count") %>%
  select(gene_id, GenomeID, Count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "gene_id", values_from = "Count") %>%
  mutate(AllPresent = case_when(`5S rRNA` > 0 & `16S rRNA` > 0 & `23S rRNA` > 0 ~ TRUE,
                                .default = FALSE))

trnas_raw <- read_tsv(here("data/ANNOTATE/collected_trnas.tsv"))
trnas <- trnas_raw %>%
  pivot_longer(!matches(c("gene_id", "AA_type", "gene_description", "category", "topic_ecosystem", "subcategory")),
               names_to = "GenomeID", values_to = "Count") %>%
  select(gene_id, GenomeID, Count) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "gene_id", values_from = "Count") %>%
  mutate(totaltrna = rowSums(across(-1), na.rm = TRUE))

```

Combine all tables into one

```{r}
chkm_qual_taxonomy <- chkm_qual %>%
  # Get an exact match to sample_name_no_space and join on that
  # since our sample columns are a bit messy
  mutate(
    sample_id = map_chr(Name, \(x) {
      matches <- metadata_raw$sample_name_no_space[
        str_detect(x, fixed(metadata_raw$sample_name_no_space))
      ]
      if (length(matches) == 0) NA_character_
      else matches[which.max(nchar(matches))]
    })
  ) %>%
  left_join(metadata_raw,by = c("sample_id" = "sample_name_no_space")) %>%
  #mutate(sample_id = str_remove(Name, "(_[^_]+){4}$")) %>% # remove last 4 underscores
  #left_join(metadata_raw, by = c("sample_id" = "sample_name_no_space")) %>%
  left_join(gtdb_assignment_bacarc, by = c("Name"="user_genome")) %>%
  separate(classification, into = c("Domain", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species"),
           sep = ";", remove = F) %>%
  left_join(trnas, by = c("Name"="GenomeID")) %>%
  left_join(rrnas, by = c("Name"="GenomeID")) %>%
  mutate(MIMAG_Quality_Classification = case_when(Completeness > 90 & Contamination < 5 & totaltrna >= 18 & AllPresent == TRUE ~ "High",
                                                     Completeness > 90 & Contamination < 5 & (totaltrna < 18 | AllPresent != TRUE) ~ "High, lacking RNAs",
                                                  Completeness > 90 & Contamination > 5 ~ "High, contaminated",
                                                  Completeness >= 50 & Contamination < 10 ~ "Medium",
                                                  Completeness >= 50 & Contamination > 10 ~ "Medium, contaminated",
                                                  Completeness < 50 & Contamination < 10 ~ "Low",
                                                  Completeness < 50 & Contamination > 10 ~ "Low, contaminated")) %>%
  mutate(MIMAG_Quality_Classification = factor(MIMAG_Quality_Classification, 
                                               levels = c("High", "High, lacking RNAs","Medium", "Low", "High, contaminated", "Medium, contaminated",
                                                          "Low, contaminated"))) %>%
  mutate(sample_id = str_remove(Name, "_[0-9]+_[0-9]+$")) %>%
  select(Name, sample_id, classification, MIMAG_Quality_Classification, Completeness, Contamination, everything())
```


```{r}
make_table(gtdb_assignment_bacarc)
```

## Assessing genome quality

Summarize by sample

```{r}
chkm_qual_taxonomy %>% 
  select(Name, classification, Completeness, Contamination, totaltrna, AllPresent, MIMAG_Quality_Classification) %>% 
  make_table()
```

```{r}
quality_by_sample <- chkm_qual_taxonomy %>%
  group_by(`Seq Project Name (No edit)`, MIMAG_Quality_Classification) %>%
  tally() %>%
  mutate(N_highqual = ifelse(MIMAG_Quality_Classification == "High", n, NA)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(`Seq Project Name (No edit)`) %>%
  fill(N_highqual, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(N_highqual = ifelse(is.na(N_highqual), 0, N_highqual)) %>%
  rename(sample_id = `Seq Project Name (No edit)`)

ggplot(quality_by_sample, aes(x = fct_reorder2(sample_id, n, N_highqual), y = n)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = MIMAG_Quality_Classification),
           position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single") ) +
  ylab("Number of Genomes") + xlab("Sample Name") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
  facet_wrap(~MIMAG_Quality_Classification, scale = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
  
```

```{r}
genomes_by_location <- chkm_qual_taxonomy %>%
  select(`Seq Project Name (No edit)`, "Sample Name*", site, material, enrichment, material, environment) %>%
  right_join(quality_by_sample, by = c("Seq Project Name (No edit)" = "sample_id"))


ggplot(chkm_qual_taxonomy, 
       aes(x = `Sample Name*`)) +

        legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot(chkm_qual_taxonomy, 
       aes(x = `material`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count", aes(fill = MIMAG_Quality_Classification),
           position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single") ) +
  ylab("Number of Genomes") + xlab("Sample Name") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

  

```

## Understand the taxonomy of the high and medium quality genomes

```{r}
ggplot(chkm_qual_taxonomy %>% filter(MIMAG_Quality_Classification %in% c("High", "High, lacking RNAs", "Medium")), 
       aes(x = `Sample Name*`)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count", aes(fill = Phylum)) +
  ylab("Number of Genomes") + xlab("Sample Name") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
  facet_wrap(~MIMAG_Quality_Classification, ncol = 1) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
